meta.robot: SOLO-12 (Open Dynamic Robot Initiative), example-robot-data solo12.urdf converted to MJCF
meta.simulator: MuJoCo 4.0.1, 2 ms physics step, policy at 50 Hz
meta.failure: front-left leg: motors off, joints locked at a tucked pose (HAA 0, HFE 1.6, KFE -2.9 rad)

original.note: wall time includes periods where the CPU was shared with other jobs

trained_3leg_reference.note: wall time includes periods where the CPU was shared with other jobs

protocol.note: prototypes evaluated outside the weights; the last row is the design compiled into policies/edited

attempts.name: FR never swings
attempts.description: front-right replays its mean stance pattern in its swing half

attempts.name: FR short swing
attempts.description: front-right swing compressed into 0.15 of the cycle

attempts.name: 3-beat gait
attempts.description: front-right and hind-left swing one after the other in the second half

attempts.name: posture only, network sees it
attempts.description: feet shifted forward-left (body back-right), offset added to the outputs

attempts.name: posture only, PD without network
attempts.description: same foot shift, fixed joint targets, no network

attempts.name: posture through an input lie
attempts.description: network told its legs are displaced the opposite way

attempts.name: posture hidden from the network
attempts.description: offset added to the outputs and subtracted from joint-pos / last-action inputs

attempts.name: FR-medial-back posture (LIP design)
attempts.description: front-right foot 5 cm back / 12 cm in, hidden, FR double stance

attempts.name: hidden posture + FR double stance
attempts.description: two short FR swings per cycle (0.40-0.50, 0.90-1.00)

attempts.name: + trims (0.7, 0.2, 0.2) + yaw loop K 0.5 (final design)
attempts.description: the design written into the weights

attempts.name: ablation: final without hiding the posture
attempts.description: posture offset and FR re-timing added to the outputs, inputs not shifted

attempts.name: ablation: final without FR re-timing
attempts.description: hidden posture + trims + yaw loop, FR keeps its original swing

attempts.name: ablation: final without posture offset
attempts.description: FR re-timing + trims + yaw loop only

attempts.name: final design + tilt feedback (rejected)
attempts.description: extra foot shift 0.1 m per unit of projected gravity x/y

attempts.name: final design + get-up reflex (rejected)
attempts.description: extra 5 cm foot shift when g_x + g_y > 0.35

fitted_to_data: N_FR: phase-averaged FR actions of the original on four legs (3 rollouts, vx 0.3 m/s)
w: fault signal weights, least-norm on four-leg observations of the original
unit freeing: least-squares fold on four-leg and three-leg observations
